what: Act One, rabble, met in packs on the Hearth Road and in the Verdant Wood. Bite, Lunge, Pack Howl.
about: A lean hunting dog gone feral in the bramble: long locks of dark fur streaked taupe, a bramble garland down the spine with spiky golden flowers in it, golden thorns hooking back toward the tail. 0.9 m to the ear tips, as in the Bestiary.
